rules.requiredAnatomy: Five fingers and toes; rounded external ears; flat nails; human dentition; no intrinsic horns, tails or unusual skin structures.
rules.identityConsistency: Persist anatomy selection; culture/clothing never rerolls biological identity.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Full natural human range of skin, eye and hair pigments; straight, wavy, curly and tightly coiled hair; freckles, birthmarks and early graying possible.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Two lower-jaw tusks (size variable); five digits per hand; ordinary plantigrade feet; rounded-to-pointed ear tips; no mandatory facial piercings or tribal markings.
rules.identityConsistency: Persist anatomy selection; culture/clothing never rerolls biological identity.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Muted green, gray-green, olive, umber and brown skin tones; dark hair common, lighter hair possible; scars and skin texture vary individually.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Five digits; rounded or slightly tapered ears; generally sparse body hair; skin patterns may resemble mottling or natural stone-like markings, not literal rock plating.
rules.identityConsistency: Persist anatomy selection; culture/clothing never rerolls biological identity.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Gray, slate, pale taupe, cool brown and stony skin tones; natural darker mottling or patches; hair may be dark, gray or pale and often sparse.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Five digits, broad hands and feet, dense hair, strong brows and jaws; female Hill Dwarves never grow facial hair.
rules.identityConsistency: Persist anatomy selection; culture/clothing never rerolls biological identity.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Warm ivory, peach, ruddy, tan, amber and copper-brown complexions; hair from blond and auburn to dark brown, black and gray.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Broad five-fingered hands, sturdy feet, heavy brow and dense bone structure; female Mountain Dwarves may grow exaggerated sideburns and hair along the jawline and chin, but never full beards; no intrinsic stone skin or metallic features.
rules.identityConsistency: Persist anatomy selection; culture/clothing never rerolls biological identity.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Paler ivory, cool beige, ash-tan and muted pink complexions common, with individual darker variants; dark, red, fair or gray hair.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Five fingers, five toes, humanlike ears with subtle taper possible; comparatively large feet, often with natural hair on tops of feet.
rules.identityConsistency: Persist anatomy selection; culture/clothing never rerolls biological identity.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Full humanlike pigmentation range; hair frequently thick or curly but not exclusively; eye colors diverse.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Long pointed ears, five digits, fine hair, expressive eyes; no mandatory antlers, wings, glowing tattoos or overt faerie appendages.
rules.identityConsistency: Persist anatomy selection; culture/clothing never rerolls biological identity.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Fair, golden, olive and woodland-brown skin; dark, chestnut, copper, blond or silver-toned hair; eye colors broad, sometimes unusually luminous-looking without actual emission.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Pointed ears, five digits, finely textured skin; no innate glowing eyes, desert scales or supernatural markings.
rules.identityConsistency: Persist anatomy selection; culture/clothing never rerolls biological identity.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Predominantly bronze, copper, olive, deep tan and brown complexions with darker pigmentation common; dark hair frequent, sun-lightened strands possible; varied eyes.

rules.requiredAnatomy: **Approved amphibious physiology:** breathe air and water; subtle subtle paired functional gill slits on the sides of the neck, behind and below the ears; mild webbing between fingers and toes; pointed ears; five digits.
rules.identityConsistency: Persist anatomy selection; culture/clothing never rerolls biological identity.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Commonly pale ivory, cool rose, pearl, light gray-beige and muted sea-toned complexions, with darker natural variation; hair pale blond, silver, sandy, brown or dark; weathering and windblown styling are acquired.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Five fingers and toes, prominent external ears, humanlike nails and teeth; no intrinsic mechanical implants or goggles.
rules.identityConsistency: Persist anatomy selection; culture/clothing never rerolls biological identity.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Humanlike range of pigmentation; vivid red, brown, blond, black and gray hair all plausible; freckles and unusual eye shades possible.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Five digits, large pointed ears, sharp canine teeth, humanlike feet; no compulsory claws, tails or oversized fangs.
rules.identityConsistency: Persist anatomy selection; culture/clothing never rerolls biological identity.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Green, olive, yellow-green, gray-green, ocher and brown complexions; hair dark, sandy, reddish or pale.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Scaled hide, clawed five-fingered hands, reptilian snout and teeth, visible tail, external ear openings rather than human ears; **no wings**; no universal breath weapon.
rules.identityConsistency: Persist anatomy selection; culture/clothing never rerolls biological identity.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Rust, ocher, red-brown, slate, green, bronze, dark umber and muted ivory scales; patterned ventral scales and horns; eye color variable.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Keratinous beak, scaled or pebbled skin, thick fingers and toes with blunt claws, dorsal shell and ventral plastron; no external human ears.
rules.identityConsistency: Persist anatomy selection; culture/clothing never rerolls biological identity.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Olive, moss, umber, tan, gray and deep green skin; shells brown, ocher, olive, charcoal or mottled; varied natural scute patterns.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Equine: long face, mobile ears, flowing mane and tail, single hard hoof per leg; deep chest and strong hindquarters.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Bay, black, chestnut, gray, roan, dun, palomino, buckskin, pinto and spotted patterns; mane and tail texture and feathering vary.
rules.sexVariationStatus: Stallions often have thicker neck crests and heavier muscle; mares often have slightly finer necks and more refined heads. Geldings are common working and racing animals. Differences are variable, not absolute.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Massive shaggy elk-like cervid with broad antler crown, deep chest, sloping muscular shoulders, long sure-footed legs and cloven hooves.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Dark umber, russet, gray-brown, soot-brown; lighter throat and belly, winter shag and mane variation.
rules.sexVariationStatus: Adult males generally bear larger antler crowns and thicker neck ruffs; females generally have finer heads and may lack antlers. Racing animals of either sex may be selected for harness-clearance traits; antler variation remains a design proposal.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Oversized domestic boar with broad chest, low center of gravity, thick winter bristles, stout legs, powerful neck, wedge-shaped snout and curved tusks.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Chestnut, black, iron gray, sandy brown, brindle and patchy coats; bristle crest and facial mask variation.
rules.sexVariationStatus: Boars commonly heavier in jowl, shoulders and tusk development; sows may have smoother head profile and smaller tusks, while remaining robust.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Graceful antlerless herbivore with light horse/deer-like head, long legs, deep but slender chest, fine neck, delicate muzzle and compact hooves.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Honey, chestnut, fawn, cream, bay, russet and soft gray, with subtle countershading and occasional dapples.
rules.sexVariationStatus: Males may show somewhat thicker neck and shoulders; females often finer through the head and limbs; neither sex has antlers.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Large muscular sheep-like ram with broad forehead, wool or hair coat, thick shoulders, split hooves and curved horn structure; selectively bred for pulling.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Cream, charcoal, slate, russet, white, black and spotted; fleece length and horn pigmentation vary.
rules.sexVariationStatus: Rams generally carry heavier horns and neck musculature; ewes often smaller horns or hornless depending on line, but powerful racing ewes remain plausible.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Canon: enormous omnivorous, social pack-oriented runner blending bear-like strength, bison-like bulk and dire-wolf-like running capacity; curved horns, thick mane, massive shoulders, strong hindquarters and cloven hooves. Canon scale: shoulder 1.8–2.3 m, body 3.5–4.5 m, 900–1,600 kg; life roughly 25–35 years.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Deep brown, black-brown, ash gray, reddish umber and pale buff, with mane and leg markings.
rules.sexVariationStatus: Males may have larger neck mane and heavier horns; females remain massive, with somewhat cleaner neck profile. This dimorphism is proposed, not previously established.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Oversized natural predatory canine with long muzzle, pronounced shoulders, deep ribcage, strong legs, thick neck ruff, large paws and heavy tail.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Gray, charcoal, cream, sable, reddish brown, black and mottled natural wolf patterns.
rules.sexVariationStatus: Males often larger and more heavily ruffed; females may be more lightly built while retaining formidable mass.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Domesticated four-legged draconic reptile with scaled hide, powerful limbs, long balancing tail and horned or crested head; no wings and no routine breath weapons or spellcasting.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Rust red, bronze, charcoal, slate, dark green; contrasting ventral scales, mottling and bands.
rules.sexVariationStatus: Males may have larger cranial horns and neck crests; females may have smoother ridges and slightly narrower heads. Variability is individual and breed-linked.

rules.requiredAnatomy: Large muscular desert-adapted oryx-like antelope with long powerful legs, strong chest and hindquarters, straight or gently swept prominent horns, distinctive facial markings. No inherent magic.
rules.sourceColorGuidance: Ivory, sand, cream, pale gold and reddish brown, with dark facial masks, flank lines and countershading.
rules.sexVariationStatus: Both sexes may be horned; males often heavier through neck and horn bases, females generally finer, subject to breeding variation.
